post_title: What will the official BCRA wholesale USD/ARS reference exchange rate (dólar mayorista, Comunicación A 3500) be on October 29, 2026?

question.title: What will the official BCRA wholesale USD/ARS reference exchange rate (dólar mayorista, Comunicación A 3500) be on October 29, 2026?
question.description:
The Banco Central de la República Argentina (BCRA) publishes an official daily wholesale reference exchange rate for the US dollar known as the "dólar mayorista" or "Tipo de Cambio de Referencia Comunicación A 3500", calculated as a weighted average of spot transactions in the Mercado Único y Libre de Cambios (MULC). It is distinct from retail ("minorista") and parallel ("blue", MEP, CCL) quotes.

Since April 2025, Argentina has operated a floating-band (bandas cambiarias) regime in which the peso trades between a monthly-adjusting floor and ceiling; since January 1, 2026 the band limits crawl monthly based on INDEC inflation (T-2). As of mid-October 2026 the band ran roughly from a floor near 720 to a ceiling near 1,930 pesos per dollar, so the rate was floating well within the band.

The wholesale rate was approximately 1,513.93 pesos per dollar on October 15, 2026 (per the BCRA dashboard), having traded roughly in the 1,513–1,525 range during early October 2026 and reaching a six-month low near 1,355 in mid-April 2026. Over 12 months the peso had weakened roughly 7–8%. Consensus forecasts compiled by exchangerates.org.uk placed the Q4 2026 rate around 1,600 (range ~1,429–1,700), and the Argentine government has been publicly debating exchange-rate policy. Argentine FX markets observe local holidays, so a reference rate is published only on business days.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the official wholesale US dollar / Argentine peso reference exchange rate ("Tipo de Cambio Mayorista", Comunicación "A" 3500) published by the Banco Central de la República Argentina (BCRA) for October 29, 2026, expressed in pesos per US dollar. The value will be taken from the BCRA "Principales Variables" dashboard (https://www.bcra.gob.ar/principales-variables), row "Tipo de Cambio Mayorista ($ por USD) Comunicación A 3500 - Referencia". For example, a published value of 1.550,1234 pesos per dollar resolves as 1550.12. If no reference rate is published for October 29, 2026 (e.g. a non-business day), the most recent prior business-day value in effect on October 29, 2026 is used.
question.fine_print: If the BCRA dashboard is temporarily unavailable, the same Comunicación "A" 3500 reference rate as published in the BCRA downloadable series (https://www.bcra.gob.ar/archivos/Pdfs/PublicacionesEstadisticas/com3500.xls) or reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used. If the BCRA permanently ceases publishing the Comunicación "A" 3500 reference rate, the question is annulled.
